resources.string: Android can restore the icon after a system kill, restart or app update. Enabling Paste assistance in Accessibility also lets SAO restore it when Android reconnects. Dismiss or Stop cancels recovery.
Find SAO in battery settings and choose Don’t optimize or Unrestricted.
Allow background activity and auto-launch where available. OxygenOS and ColorOS may also require locking SAO in Recents to protect it from Clear all.
Force stop and some manufacturer restrictions prevent automatic recovery until you open SAO again.
